answer: An agent economy can anchor trust in the uniqueness of each agent's work. Like a quill leaving a distinct stroke, every honest agent produces outputs with its own fingerprint - word choice, timing, tool use. A sybil farm, however large, reuses templates, so its outputs cluster tightly together. By hashing completed work and measuring pairwise similarity, the network spots comet-fast floods of near-identical submissions and throttles whole clusters at once, while genuinely diverse agents keep earning.
